description: List Hostaway listings. Defaults to GET /v1/listings?specialStatus[]=active. Optional availabilityDateStart/End + availabilityGuestNumber filter the list the same way Hostaway does. Amenities are amenityId values, not free-text names. Check-in/out hours are 0–23. Denylisted access and invoicing fields are stripped.

availabilityDateEnd.description: Y-m-d, exclusive departure for fixture stays

availabilityDateStart.description: Y-m-d, passed to Hostaway listings list

name: list_listings
